checks.description: Something the camera can see renders geometry (object, collection, view-layer and instancer visibility)
Render geometry has finite, non-collapsed world transforms (parents included)
The subject is inside the camera frame and not hidden behind other objects

checks.description: The subject fills at least 0.5% of the frame and at least 35% of it lies inside the frame
A light that reaches the subject, a non-black world or an emissive material on visible geometry
checks.detail: no lights; world strength 0.0; emissive materials not on any visible object: 'Unused glow'

checks.description: Every visible object that renders geometry has a material
No image used by a visible material or the world is missing on disk
Effective render resolution is at least 256 x 256
Animation keys are finite and fall inside the scene frame range
No group of objects floats above the surface below it (--strict-contact)

note: Technical gates are not an aesthetic score. They are computed from scene geometry, not pixels.
